blocks.heading: Our Services
blocks.text: We provide a wide range of professional dental services in Frisco to meet your needs. We promise to provide every service with a smile, and to the highest level of satisfaction. Become A Patient Invisalign → Cosmetic Dentistry → Dental Crowns → Family Dentistry → Implants →

blocks.heading: Invisalign
blocks.text: Want a straight smile that shows your inner confidence without traditional metal braces? Introducing Invisalign, the clear way to get the smile you’ve always wanted. Invisalign works by adjusting the teeth using applied pressure. But unlike braces, you don’t have to give up on popcorn, candy, gum, or any of your favorite foods. Invisalign is also more comfortable when compared to traditional braces. There are no wires that have to be adjusted or other annoyances. Instead, you’ll have to wear thin, transparent aligners that gently adjust crowded and crooked teeth. Invisalign aligners are made out of durable, medical-grade plastic. The aligners are almost undetectable and can be popped in and out easily. This virtually eliminates any interference to your daily life, whether you’re at work or at home. Every few weeks, you’ll receive a new set of aligners that will shift your teeth ever so slightly. By the end of the treatment, your teeth will be exactly where they should be! Learn More

blocks.heading: Cosmetic Dentistry
blocks.text: Our cosmetic dentistry solutions are world-class, and hundreds of patients trust them and rely on us for their dental needs. With Dr. Philips' unique skills and long experience, we can provide customized and ideal solutions for most aesthetic dental issues. Learn More

blocks.heading: Dental Crowns
blocks.text: A dental crown is a good treatment for a damaged tooth. Besides helping restore your smile, the crowns also assist in restoring a tooth that would be otherwise be extracted. Dentists recommend crowns because they have multiple benefits. Learn More

blocks.heading: Family Dentistry
blocks.text: At Frisco Dental Care, we are your one-stop shop for all your family's dental care needs. We attend to patients of all age groups, from infants to seniors. And unlike other facilities that will treat you as just a number, we consider each of our clients as a unique case because we understand that each person's condition is exceptional. Learn More

blocks.heading: Dental Implants
blocks.text: A dental implant is a prosthesis that connects with the bone of the jaw to support a crown, bridge, or denture. Learn More

blocks.heading: Over 30 Years of Comfortable, Quality Dentistry
blocks.text: We know that going to the dentist can be difficult sometimes, so we do everything we can to make sure you're relaxed and comfortable in our Frisco dental office. Our first priority is to treat you as we want to be treated: with respect, patience, and clarity.

blocks.heading: Get to Know Dr. Garry C. Phillips
blocks.text: Dr. Phillips is a Texas native who has been practicing and enjoying dentistry for over 40 years now! His Frisco dental office is equipped with the latest technology, including digital X-rays, which use less than a tenth of the radiation as film X-rays, as well as digital scanners, intraoral cameras, and high-quality, natural-looking dental materials. What really sets our practice apart from the rest, however, is his dedication to providing each and every patient with the phenomenal dental care they deserve. To learn more about what inspired him to become a dentist and his educational background, read on!

blocks.heading: Why Did You Decide to Become a Dentist?
blocks.text: Since Dr. Phillips’ parents never completed high school, he broke the mold by going on to higher education! He has always loved working with his hands, and the fact that he could do so as a dentist immediately drew him to the dental field. Now, he uses a gentle hand, the latest dental techniques, and a compassionate approach to show those in his treatment chair that preventive, restorative, and cosmetic dentistry doesn’t hurt. He also loves telling horrible dad jokes to help relax his patients!

blocks.heading: Where Did You Study Dentistry?
blocks.text: Dr. Phillips’ 40+ year career in dentistry began at the University of Texas Health Science Center at San Antonio. He earned his DDS degree and worked in the Army in a medical research unit, which focused on doubling the shelf life of stored blood. After that, Dr. Phillips’ came to Frisco Dental Care, and he’s been helping his friends, family, and neighbors at this office for more than two decades now! He is so passionate about providing exceptional care that he completes over 12 hours of advanced dental continuing education every year. Plus, he maintains active memberships with the American Dental Association, the Texas Dental Association, and The Dallas County Dental Association.

blocks.heading: Leigh, Front Office Coordinator
blocks.text: Leigh has over 30 years of experience in the dental field. Her calm, helpful and cheerful personality is what our patients like so much about her! She has been married for 25 years with 2 beautiful daughters. In her free time, she loves to travel to the beach and spend time with her family. Her favorite food is Mexican, along with a margarita. -->

blocks.heading: Roxanne, Registered Dental Hygienist
blocks.text: Roxanne (Roxy) has an impressive 16+ years of experience in the dental field under her belt, and she’s been an important member of our team for more than four years now! As a Texas native, she chose to complete her studies at Texas Woman’s University (which is where she earned her bachelor’s degree in dental hygiene). Now, she loves using everything she has learned to help patients in her treatment chair improve their oral health. On the evenings and weekends, Roxanne enjoys watching movies, seeing live bands, traveling, and spending time with loved ones. Here’s a fun fact about her: she’s fluent in Spanish! Roxanne (Roxy) has been working as a Dental Hygienist for over 13 years now. She is very dedicated to the dental care profession and enjoys educating patients on the importance of oral health. She graduated from Collin College in 2008. Roxy is fluent in Spanish and English. In her spare time, Roxy likes to travel, spend time with family and friends, listen to live music and keep active doing anything outdoors. She is also a big Dallas Cowboys fan. -->

blocks.heading: Cheryl, Registered Dental Hygienist
blocks.text: Cheryl has been in the dental field since 1999. She attended Texas A&M University and received a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Science, later completing the Dental Hygiene program at Collin College. She started off as an oral surgery assistant throughout college, which sparked her interest in the dental field. Cheryl enjoys learning new things and is very appreciative of the people she has met during her dental career that have guided her along the way. She feels so blessed to have met some amazing patients, teachers, classmates, co-workers, employers, and dentists, each one teaching her something new. She strives to give each patient personal care and treat them like family, making them as comfortable as possible. She grew up in Carrollton but calls Frisco home. She stays very active with her 3 kiddos and all of their extracurricular activities.

blocks.heading: Rachelle, Registered Dental Assistant
blocks.text: As a 20 year dental assistant who began her career in oral surgery and periodontal assisting, her "tracks" lead her to Frisco Dental Care where she continues to learn and build on her assisting abilities. She upholds the standards of patient care, health, and the amazing dental aesthetics achieved with Dr. Phillips's attention to detail. In her home life, she enjoys recycling, taking care of homeless animals (wild and domestic), and remodeling her home.

blocks.heading: Smile Investment: What Affects the Cost of Dental Implants?
blocks.text: August 29, 2026 Dental implants are considered the top solution for replacing missing teeth because they can provide a stable, natural-looking restoration. However, one of the first questions many patients have is, “How much do dental implants cost?” The answer can vary considerably because several factors influence the total price of treatment. (more…)

blocks.heading: How Long Does Cosmetic Dentistry Last?
blocks.text: July 29, 2026 If you’re considering improving your smile with cosmetic dentistry , one of the first questions you may have is, “How long will the results last?” The answer depends on the type of treatment you receive, your oral hygiene habits, and your lifestyle. While no cosmetic procedure lasts forever, many treatments can provide beautiful results for years or even decades with proper care. Here’s a look at the longevity of some of the most common cosmetic dental procedures. (more…)

blocks.heading: How Can You Speed Up Your Invisalign Treatment?
blocks.text: June 29, 2026 One of the biggest advantages of Invisalign is that it straightens teeth discreetly while allowing you to eat and brush without the restrictions of traditional braces. Naturally, many patients wonder if there’s a way to finish treatment even sooner. While your teeth can only move safely at a certain rate, there are several things you can do to help keep your Invisalign treatment on schedule and avoid unnecessary delays. (more…)

blocks.heading: Convenience at a Cost: 5 Dangers of Mail-In Clear Aligners
blocks.text: May 23, 2026 Mail-in clear aligners have become a popular search for anyone looking at Invisalign alternatives in Frisco and beyond. The ads are hard to miss, and they all promise straight teeth from home, with no office visits, at a fraction of the cost. But before you click “add to cart,” you should know what you could be signing up for. Here are five real risks that come with skipping professional Invisalign treatment . (more…)

blocks.heading: How Long Will I Wear a Retainer After Invisalign Treatment?
blocks.text: April 1, 2026 Finishing your Invisalign treatment is an exciting milestone, but it’s not the end of your orthodontic journey. To keep your newly straightened smile in place, wearing a retainer is essential. Many patients wonder how long they’ll need to wear one, and the honest answer is: longer than you might expect. (more…)

blocks.heading: Top 3 Minimal Dental Cosmetic Treatments
blocks.text: March 26, 2026 Some cosmetic treatments just aren’t worth the effort. Plus, if you only want to fix a few minor aesthetic imperfections, you don’t really need a complicated dental procedure anyway! Cosmetic dentistry has plenty of low-commitment options for enhancing your smile. When it comes to minimal treatment planning and conservative techniques, these three easily make the top of the list. (more…)

blocks.heading: 4 Reasons Cosmetic Dentistry Has Become So Popular
blocks.text: February 1, 2026 Cosmetic dentistry has experienced a major rise in popularity over the past decade. From teeth whitening to veneers and clear aligners, more people than ever are investing in their smiles. While improving appearance has always been a motivating factor, today’s surge in demand goes beyond vanity. Here are 4 key reasons cosmetic dentistry has become so popular. (more…)

blocks.heading: Oral Anatomy: Different Parts of the Mouth & Their Purpose
blocks.text: January 1, 2026 The mouth plays a vital role in everyday functions such as speaking, chewing, swallowing, and even breathing. While many people think of the mouth as simply teeth and gums, it is actually a complex system made up of several structures that work together to maintain oral health and support overall wellness. Understanding oral anatomy can help you better care for your mouth and recognize when something may not be functioning properly. (more…)

blocks.heading: All About Smile Gaps: Why They Can Happen and How to Fix Them
blocks.text: December 6, 2025 A gap between the teeth is known as a diastema. It’s a trait that many people adore, but there are plenty who feel self-conscious about it. If you’re a part of the latter group, you may wonder what options you have to close the space that bothers you, especially if it’s between your two front teeth. Your dentist is here to help with several cosmetic dental treatments . Here’s what you need to know to feel confident making a choice for your oral health. (more…)

blocks.heading: High-Quality, Custom-Tailored Dental Restorations
blocks.text: Although dental restorations may sound like a serious dental intervention, they’re quite common. In fact, an estimated 66 percent of the U.S. population has at least one restoration! Dr. Phillips utilizes high-quality, natural-looking, and durable dental materials to make your repaired teeth seamlessly integrate with the rest of your smile, all while preserving its strength and structure. Call Frisco Dental Care today to learn more about these services and how they can help your smile thrive.

blocks.heading: Tooth-Colored Fillings
blocks.text: Most people will have at least one cavity filling at some point in their life. In the past, these would be made from noticeable metal amalgamations. However, today, we utilize a tooth-colored biocompatible resin that seals off the affected tooth and protects it from further damage, all while minimizing dental sensitivity and preventing the decay from progressing.

blocks.heading: Dental Bridges
blocks.text: For our patients missing one or more teeth in a row, a dental bridge can close the gap in the arch to make basic daily tasks like chewing and speaking much easier. These restorations contain two crowns that anchor the restoration to the two healthy teeth on either side of the space in the mouth, cementing free-standing replacement teeth (pontics) firmly in place. The result is a whole and functional set of pearly whites.

blocks.heading: Dentures
blocks.text: Depending on the location and number of teeth you’re missing, Dr. Phillips may recommend either a full or partial denture to restore your smile. Full dentures are designed to use suction to stay firmly atop the gumline, while partial dentures have a metal or acrylic base that’s designed to fit like a puzzle piece around your existing teeth. Both will help you regain your chewing abilities as well as provide you with other priceless benefits, like a confidence boost.

blocks.heading: A Comfortable, Metal-Free Orthodontic Treatment
blocks.text: Want a straight smile that shows your inner confidence without traditional braces? Good news: we offer Invisalign! This innovative orthodontic treatment ensures you can achieve the results you desire without wearing noticeable, metal brackets and wires. If you are interested in learning more about this teeth-straightening service, including the factors that impact the cost, read on or call our team at Frisco Dental Care.

blocks.heading: How Invisalign Works
blocks.text: In just four easy steps, you’ll be on your way to the smile of your dreams. In-office consultation . You’ll meet with one of the dentists at Frisco Dental Care for a thorough examination and to discuss your alignment goals. Then, they will determine if Invisalign can provide the results you want. Customized treatment plan . A 3D scanner is used to take impressions of your teeth. Before and after images will be created to show the dramatic results that Invisalign can offer. Creating your aligners. After we take your impressions, we will send them off to the lab so your custom aligners can be made. You’ll wear each aligner for two weeks and then move to the next ones to slowly shift the teeth into place. Smile with confidence. After wearing your Invisalign aligners as directed, you’ll have the straight, beautiful smile that you’ve always wanted. In just a matter of months, the gorgeous results you’ve been dreaming of will be yours!

blocks.heading: Who Can Invisalign Help?
blocks.text: Invisalign can help patients with all kinds of orthodontic problems, including overbites. So, if you don’t like the idea of wearing metal brackets and wires, then don’t hesitate to schedule a consultation with us! In the meantime, you can read on to learn more about who Invisalign can help. Read More

blocks.heading: Crowded Teeth
blocks.text: Do your teeth overlap? If so, it’s important to schedule a consultation at our office to explore your treatment options. After all, even relatively mild cases of overcrowding can negatively impact your self-esteem and oral health. The good news is that Invisalign is often a solution, and, if that’s the case, your journey to a straighter, healthier smile won’t involve any metal brackets or wires.

blocks.heading: Gaps Between Teeth
blocks.text: Maybe you’re interested in Invisalign because you’re struggling with the opposite problem: there is too much space in your mouth. If that’s the case, then you’ll be happy to hear that patients with mild to moderate gaps are often candidates. If we determine that’s the case for you as well, then we can close the gaps with clear, barely noticeable aligners.

blocks.heading: Overbite
blocks.text: In addition to improving the alignment of your teeth, Invisalign can improve the alignment of your bite. So, if your upper teeth protrude beyond your lower ones, don’t just assume that traditional braces are your only option! You may be pleasantly surprised to find out that we can achieve the same results with clear, comfortable, and convenient aligners.

blocks.heading: Underbite
blocks.text: If you’re struggling to smile confidently, chew properly, and enunciate clearly because your lower teeth sit in front of your upper ones, let us know! That way, we can complete a comprehensive oral exam, assess the severity of your underbite, and determine if you’re a good candidate for Invisalign. If the answer is “yes,” then we will get to work creating your custom treatment plan.

blocks.heading: Crossbite
blocks.text: Some patients only have a few upper teeth that sit behind their lower ones when they bite down. If that’s the case for you as well, then you likely have a crossbite. Since this orthodontic problem can lead to several issues, including premature wear, it’s important that you explore your treatment options, like Invisalign clear aligners.

blocks.heading: Open Bite
blocks.text: When you bite down, is there a space between your upper and lower teeth? If you answered “yes,” then there’s a good chance that you have an open bite. Fortunately, we offer several solutions at our office, including Invisalign. Sometimes, the clear aligners need to be used in tandem with other orthodontic accessories, like rubber bands. If that’s the case, we will let you know during your consultation.
